title: EZTerminal runtime architecture
summary: How desktop surfaces cross narrow trust boundaries into terminal, agent, remote, and durable OpenClaw runtimes.

chapters.title: Desktop request path
chapters.summary: Follow a renderer action through preload and main into the isolated interpreter.

chapters.title: Remote boundary
chapters.summary: Main projects bounded runtime capabilities to authenticated remote clients.

chapters.title: OpenClaw resilience
chapters.summary: A per-login Windows supervisor reconciles durable desired state independently of the Electron window lifetime.

nodes.label: React and Dockview workbench
nodes.detail: Native panels render product state and issue typed requests.

evidence.claim: The workbench registers native Dockview panel components, including Project Map.

nodes.label: Isolated preload bridge
nodes.detail: Only explicit desktop APIs cross context isolation.

evidence.claim: The desktop API is exposed through one named context bridge surface.

nodes.label: Electron main authorities
nodes.detail: Main owns filesystem, Git, process, window, and capability enforcement.

evidence.claim: Main constructs Project Workspace and Project Map authorities and broadcasts bounded change events.

nodes.label: Interpreter broker
nodes.detail: The broker owns session and run transport between main and the utility process.

evidence.claim: InterpreterBroker is the main-side owner of interpreter session and run messaging.

nodes.label: Utility interpreter runtime
nodes.detail: Commands and PTYs execute outside the Electron main thread.

evidence.claim: The interpreter listens on the utility process parent port and handles typed main messages.

nodes.label: Authenticated remote bridge
nodes.detail: A bounded WebSocket protocol mirrors approved terminal and desktop capabilities.

evidence.claim: Each remote connection receives isolated run, upload, packet, and terminal capability state.

nodes.label: Windows OpenClaw supervisor
nodes.detail: A current-user Scheduled Task reconciles durable desired state, authenticated readiness, and bounded safe repair outside the Electron lifetime.

evidence.claim: The per-login supervisor continuously reconciles persisted desired state and authenticated gateway health, while preserving blocked attempts for the next explicit request.
Preload maps project requests to named IPC channels without exposing ipcRenderer.
Main validates Project Workspace and Project Map IPC payloads before dispatch.
SessionSurfaceAuthority resolves intent and asks the broker to create or adopt sessions.
runCommand creates a dedicated channel and transfers one port to the interpreter.
Remote run observation encodes interpreter frames before sending them to a client.

relations.label: atomic desired intent and runtime receipt

evidence.claim: Main coalesces matching requests, persists a monotonic desired-state intent atomically, wakes the supervisor, and returns an immediate receipt.
